payload.description_html:
Fig 53. Macropoma lewesiensis.

Restoration of (A) the skull roof, in dorsal view, and (B) the cheek and the lower jaw in left lateral view. Course of the sensory canals is in light red. The pit lines are in light orange. The openings of the rostral organ are in green. The openings of the nostrils are in blue. Illustrations redrawn after Forey ([7], figs 3.19a, 3.21a, 4.18 and 4.19). The extrascapular series is drawn according to the one preserved in M. precursor.

https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0320214.g053
